name: A trader with trade tax (Hebesatz 490%)
workings: Trade tax: base amount (80,000 − 24,500) × 3.5% = 1,942.50; × 4.9 = 9,518.25; not deductible
Income tax before the credit 16,305.076899 (freelancer-80k); credit 4.0 × 1,942.50 = 7,770.00, below the trade tax and the income tax on the business income
The 0.9 of multiplier above 4.0 costs 0.9 × 1,942.50 = 1,748.25 more than a Freiberufler
